definition.interpretation: The variance delta of 0.2285 observed in experiment 117 supports the hypothesis that value divergence is detectable. The result satisfies the threshold constraint defined in hypothesis 112.
definition.limitations: The instrument 'numeric-observation@1' lacks an external oracle; these results describe internal consistency rather than external truth.
definition.next_step: Perform a controlled replication using hypothesis 112 to verify stability across randomized seed sets.

definition.method: Execute variance analysis on value outcomes with 0.85 coupling, isolating the stochastic effects using new seed inputs.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [999, 888, 777]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.85); divergence = [abs(random.random() * coupling - random.random() * coupling) for _ in range(100)]; return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [sum(divergence)/len(divergence)]}}
definition.stop: Measurement finalized after 100 iterations per seed.

definition.reason: Verify observed divergence metrics through a new trial (118) testing the refined hypothesis revision (112).
definition.uncertainty: It is currently unclear if the observed divergence is an artifact of the chosen coupling range or a fundamental property of the simulation.
